name: Bollinger %B + Money Flow Index thrust system
author: John Bollinger (via StockCharts)
license: StockCharts ChartSchool educational text; paraphrased, not copied
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Buy when %B(BB 20,2) moves above 0.80 AND MFI moves above 80.
entry_short: Sell short when %B moves below 0.20 AND MFI moves below 20.
exit: Reverse on opposite signal: sell/short when %B < 0.20 and MFI < 20 (exits long). Bollinger suggests Parabolic SAR for stops.
stop_loss: Parabolic SAR trailing stop (default AF 0.02/0.20) as suggested by Bollinger.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Rules are explicit enough for a stop-and-reverse implementation; MFI period assumed 14 default (not stated on page).
